name: Disability Aged Care
shortDescription: Aged care and disability support that helps older South Australians with disability live as independently as possible.
plainEnglishSummary: If you are over 65 and living with disability, DHS Disability Services may help you explore suitable aged care support. Residential care at Northgate may be available for people requiring a high level of assistance.
audience: South Australians over 65 who are living with disability
Older people with disability who need help living independently
People with high support needs seeking residential aged care
People accessing My Aged Care or Disability Supports for Older Australians
supportTypes: Help exploring aged care and funding options
availabilityNote: Support is provided through funding arrangements including My Aged Care and Disability Supports for Older Australians. Residential aged care at Northgate may be available for people with high support needs. Service access, costs and placement availability depend on individual assessment, funding and vacancies.
eligibilityNote: Community Connect cannot confirm eligibility, funding or residential placement. This service is intended for older South Australians with disability. Contact DHS Disability Services to discuss age requirements, support needs, My Aged Care or DSOA funding, costs and current vacancies.
